a.lede: Experiencing SOS mode on your iPhone 18 Pro Max with AT&T? Apple confirms a hardware issue and details who needs a replacement.
a.title: Apple acknowledges AT&T network bug on iPhone 18 Pro Max

b.lede: Some iPhone 18 Pro Max phones on AT&T are stuck in SOS mode. Two updates can prevent it, but affected phones need replacing.
b.title: iPhone 18 Pro Max can’t call or text on AT&T? Apple will replace it for free
